Reference foreground chairs are larger and the desk rows recede obliquely; the candidate is more frontal, with a smaller window and more uniformly scaled, horizontally aligned furniture. The far-right candidate chair is cropped. Camera, lens and layout jointly affect these differences; no aligned 3D error follows (reference and delivered images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:43-48,50-72,83).

Foreground chair backs face the camera and the scripted local forward is +Y; two chairs have nonzero yaw (/evidence/final_source/build.py:50-53,72). Exact reference yaw, hidden depth, and symmetry-ambiguous chair base orientation are not identifiable from the image. Chair/desk occlusions support only visible depth order; do not infer unique distances.
